quarterly_data.signal: Flex's 10-K discloses a commercial relationship with Amazon.com, Inc.: a warrant issued on August 15, 2025 to a wholly-owned Amazon subsidiary vests based on qualifying payments for the purchase of all products and services by or on behalf of Amazon and its affiliates, and the related expense is recorded as a deduction to revenue as the customer purchases products and services.
